a higher transfer_likelihood must outweigh a concrete experimental mismatch.

independent evidence. Return exactly one valid JSON object and do not reveal

L1/L2 high-F analogies (palmitic acid, oxybate, neotame, lefamulin, eplerenone, valomaciclovir stearate, nortilidine, desethyloxybutynin, UDCA, pethidine) are from different chemical classes and are outweighed by the more relevant prostaglandin-analog exposure pattern.
